sent_bad: Unlike HEVs, they can be plugged in: "PHEV batteries can be charged several ways: by an outside electric power source, by the internal combustion engine, or through regenerative braking."
EVs have no combustion engine or other fuel: "EVs use a battery to store the electrical energy that powers the motor.

In short, the key distinctions are: HEVs charge only via regenerative braking and the engine (no plug); PHEVs add plug-in charging and a larger battery enabling 10–40 miles of all-electric driving; EVs have no fuel-based propulsion at all, relying solely on a plugged-in battery.
